body: Each level grants a little more freedom than the one before it.
instruction: Select a level to open it, then open the next.

_items.title: Level 1 — Read only
_items.body: You can view records and reports, but you cannot change anything.
_items.advice: Start here if you are new to the system and just need to find information.

_items.title: Level 2 — Contributor
_items.body: You can create and edit your own entries, which a reviewer then approves.
_items.advice: Save often and add a clear note explaining what you changed and why.

_items.title: Level 3 — Administrator
_items.body: You can manage other people's entries and change the settings for your team.
_items.advice: Use this access carefully — changes here affect everyone in your team at once.
